method: Out of sample: walk-forward predictions of our production models, refitted every month on earlier matches only, 2019/20 to 2025/26, 21 domestic leagues. 'Usual' is the share of all matches on that route that ended 5+ shots above our expected total; 'our curve' is what our own published curves gave for the same matches. Every condition is known before kick-off. A signal is used only on a route where its difference from our curve has a 95% interval that excludes zero and held in at least 5 of the 7 seasons. It is a lean, not a promise: probabilities on the site are unchanged. A match carries at most one of the three season-end signals (the strongest that applies).

signals.label: Nothing to play for
signals.explanation: Neither team can still reach the title or drop into the relegation places, with 10 or fewer league games left. Matches with nothing at stake have ended 5+ shots above our expected total more often than our curve said.

signals.label: One side with nothing to play for
signals.explanation: One of the two teams can no longer reach the title or the relegation places, with 10 or fewer league games left.

signals.label: Last three league games
signals.explanation: At least one of the teams is playing one of its last three league matches of the season.

signals.label: Head-to-head runs high
signals.explanation: Earlier meetings of these two clubs averaged at least 4 more shots than our expected total for this one (recent meetings count more).

signals.label: Both in a low-scoring run
signals.explanation: Both teams' last five matches were low-scoring (bottom fifth). With ordinary shot volume, low-scoring runs have meant more shooting, not less.

signals.label: Recent games above ratings
signals.explanation: The two teams' last three matches averaged more shots than their opponent-adjusted ratings expected (top fifth).

signals.label: Strong home side, weak visitor
signals.explanation: The home team's rating is far above the visitor's (top tenth of rating gaps).

signals.label: December or January
signals.explanation: Matches in December and January have ended 5+ shots above our expected total less often than our curve said.

signals.label: Recent games below ratings
signals.explanation: The two teams' last three matches averaged fewer shots than their opponent-adjusted ratings expected (bottom fifth).
